requirement.text: Ability to take a simple problem or business scenario and turn it into a solution that interacts with multiple software components, writing clear, easily understood, well tested and extensible code
requirement.source_span: You have mastered taking a simple problem or business scenario into a solution that interacts with multiple software components, and executing on it by writing clear, easily understood, well tested and extensible code.

evidence: Designed, built, and shipped a full stack application, in production with local businesses (beta), owning every layer from concept to production: a React/TypeScript front end, a Python/PostgreSQL back end.
Implemented microservice architecture to facilitate client requests and database management boosting code maintainability.
Modeled data tables with SQLAlchemy, backed by Jest tests, ensuring reliable functionality.

requirement.text: Comfortable navigating a large code base, debugging others' code, and providing feedback through code reviews
requirement.source_span: You are comfortable navigating a large code base, debugging others' code, and providing feedback to other engineers through code reviews.

evidence: Conducted thorough code reviews that reduced bug-related issues by 40%, ensuring high-quality production features.
Uphold coding standards through comprehensive code reviews while managing Agile task delegation for high-quality, on-time delivery.
Coach engineers on core professional skills: debugging, troubleshooting, version control, and effective research methods, accelerating their growth and collaboration.

requirement.text: Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent practical experience
requirement.source_span: This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor's degree in a related field.

evidence: Full Stack Web Development, Rithm School, San Francisco, CA, Mar 2022 – Jun 2022
